title: CHEN-V 更新 1.02
body:
CHEN-V 更新到 V1.02。

优化：锁定（禁用）的控件背景改为半透明，能透出界面背景图，不再是实心色块；阈值、帧率、并行数等数值框不再叠成不透明方块。

更新后记得重启程序，祝使用愉快。

en.title: CHEN-V updated to 1.02
en.body:
CHEN-V is now V1.02.

Improved: disabled controls now use a translucent background so the interface wallpaper shows through instead of a solid block, and number boxes (threshold, frame rate, job count) no longer render as opaque squares.

Restart the app after updating. Enjoy!
